Method of Attack: Downloads and executes AZORult Trojan (azo.exe) which then downloads and executes Hermes 2.1 Ransomware (hrms.exe)
Hermes 2.1 Ransomware encrypts files without changing filenames and drops DECRYPT_INFORMATION.html ransom notes
Attack Vector: Malspam email with subject 'Invoice Due' containing password-protected Word document attachment (Invoice.doc) with macros
